acceptance.accepted_history_rule: Only the event exactly anchored by CURRENT.latest_event commit+path+digest is accepted history.
acceptance.canonicalization_gate: Decode JSON member-name escapes, then reject repeated decoded member names before object construction, canonicalization, idempotency derivation, or event hashing.
acceptance.duplicate_rule: Existing deterministic claim path is DUPLICATE; do not replace claim, outbox, event, or CURRENT.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Fetch CURRENT again; it must remain exact v73/blob eccf470a03a38aa8f63fb4c361cf4efb3b850cb8/stored projection digest c0b2cc081dac3657fd2cdb9787d6aa91a4d9f8a638d8994cf9c9aa9b02da51b0 before one blob-SHA-guarded replacement; final readback must be v74.
acceptance.slack_gate: Slack post is prohibited before exact v74 readback anchors this event commit+path+digest; then post one sanitized exact-marker pointer and append one immutable delivery receipt.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This is one local Python parser and one strict object-pairs hook, not a cross-language, streaming-parser, RFC 8785, or standards conformance test. The controlled specimen exercises one top-level literal-versus-escaped-equivalent member name only; nested escaped-equivalent duplicates, surrogate handling, normalization policy, other escape forms, and independent implementations remain untested. The strict gate demonstrates decoded-name duplicate rejection in this wake but does not prove every producer applies it before hashing. Claim, outbox, event, CURRENT replacement, Slack post, and delivery receipt are separate effects. Git supplies branch-local create-only paths and a single-file prior-blob-SHA replacement precondition only; it provides no cross-file transaction, database uniqueness or isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, force-push safety, cross-branch exclusion, or Slack atomicity.

probe.name: JSON_ESCAPED_EQUIVALENT_MEMBER_REJECTION_V1

operation_payload.controlled_factor: Vary only whether the second raw JSON member spelling is a Unicode escape that decodes to the same member name as an earlier literal key. Keep decoded values, all other members, UTF-8 encoding, restricted integer values, canonical serializer, object version chain, and write protocol fixed.
operation_payload.hypothesis: Duplicate detection must occur after JSON string escape decoding but before object construction, canonicalization, idempotency derivation, or hashing; otherwise literal 'a' and escaped '\u0061' can collapse silently under a last-wins parser.

measured_result.result: The ordinary local parser decoded the escaped key and applied last-wins behavior, collapsing the escaped-equivalent duplicate specimen onto the unique control. The strict object-pairs gate observed decoded names and rejected the second 'a' before canonicalization.

native_task_read.title: HFO X12 Durable Object PDCA Lab

operation_payload.result_contract: Record local decoded-key behavior exactly; require duplicate detection on decoded member names before canonicalization; do not claim RFC/JCS conformance or parser independence.

probe.strongest_falsifier: A strict replay accepts the literal-plus-escaped-equivalent duplicate, the ordinary parser does not collapse the two specimens as recorded, raw or canonical digests fail recomputation, the deterministic claim already existed but state still advances, CURRENT is not exact v73 on the second read, or final event/CURRENT binding fails.

canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete the claim, outbox, event, Slack message, or receipt. If v74 is later invalid, append a compensating transition from the then-current exact version. Correct decoded-member duplicate policy only through a later versioned event.
